games.name: Defend your Box Fort from Monsters
Thats not my Robloxian
games.desc:
Inspired by indie game That's not my Neighbor (Credits to Nacho Sama) this is a Roblox take on the game.

🎉 Welcome to the Clone Analysis Team (C.A.T.) - we need YOU!

🌟 It's 2012, and mysteriously, clones are becoming more common than ever. C.A.T. is on the case!

🕵️‍♂️ Your mission? Decide who gets access and who doesn't. Seems straightforward, right? But beware! Missing even the tiniest detail could turn you into clone chow!

🙏 Please give support to Nacho Sama by playing the original game.

Tags: Neighbor, Thatsnotmy, That'snotmy, ThatsNotMyNeighbor, That'sNotMyNeighbor, Doppelganger, Clone, Horror, PapersPlease, Cats
